title: Esho Maa Lakshmi
desc: A tale of Goddess Lakshmi that describes her divine origin, celestial beauty, and role as the bestower of wealth and prosperity in Hindu mythology.

title: Maya Mamata
desc: Mamata is the daughter of a wealthy industrialist who is married to Anil. However, when her mother-in-law drives her away, she strives to find love again.

title: Matir Manush
desc: After Meeting With An Accident, Payel Falls In Love With A Man. Things Turn When Her Father Disapproves Of Their Relationship.

title: Suorani Duorani
desc: The king of Kishangarh marries a girl, unaware that she is a demoness. Upon learning the truth about his stepmother, the prince decides to save his father and their kingdom from her evil plans.

title: Badnam
desc: Mathur Ghosh's cruelty drives Haranath to suicide. Years later, Haranath's son Shankar grows up determined to avenge his father's death by seeking justice against the evil Mathur Ghosh.

title: Mem Saheb
desc: Kajal falls in love with Amit, an unemployed journalist. She urges him to focus on his career and provides unconditional support, but destiny has other plans for the couple.
